author: mrdollar
quote:
There are a lot of problems in the game. Worst Valve's game for sure, except Artifact. Also requires way too much PC power (bad optimization) and additional VR equipment.

- No sprinting, no crouching, no jumping - only teleportation, witch instantly brakes immersion
- No smooth turning, it really makes you motion sick fast enough
- No arms, only floating hands really look weird
- Cannot use objects and your arms to defend or attack the enemy
- locomotion moves at snails pace, pathetic attempt to prolong the game
- Some objects cannot be interacted with like you can move chair, but can move table, feels strange
- Too many invisible walls, brakes immersion
- Terrible voice acting of Alyx, really lame jokes and annoying Russel
- Levels are very linear, you can't stray of form main path at all.

author: mrdollar
quote:
1. Tired of missing 90% hit rates, your soldier literately misses point blank shots without cover all the time.
2. Almost every mission is timed of 6-8 turns and you are fighting 4-5 groups of enemies.
3. Optimization of game is really bad, even high end pc lags using higher graphics settings.
4. Bugs and glitches, you can easily cheat saving the game before enemy turn and load. It will skip enemy turn lol.
5. When you counter enemy on your last move, enemy gain second turn, not fair.

author: mrdollar
quote:
It's 2017 for gods sake. Worst game ever this year. Are they right in their head to release this?

- Animations are inexcusable (worst i ever saw in a decade)
- Face animations is garbage, lifeless eyes, they don't even move the heads properly
- Bugs amount is out of control
- Bland and boring main story
- Voice acting and music uninspiring
- Soulless and empty feeling even in crowded places (the npc most of the time only stands)

+ Nice space views to look from ship

After Witcher 3 the bar for games was rised quite high. Couldn't even force myself to finish the game. Everyone who bought should demand refund.
